description.narrative: The EBRD and the COM are providing support to the City of Tokmok to rehabilitate water supply services and selected wastewater improvements in the City. Investments are expected to significantly improve access to clean water, reduce water losses, improve resilience to climate change and optimise operating costs for the Tokmok Water Company.

title.narrative: Number of beneficiaries living below the poverty line

description.narrative: Currently 14 per cent of the population of Tokmok (4.480) are considered poor or extremely poor

comment.narrative: There is no Baseline value introduced in the table with the indicators but the figures are provided in the comments for the concerned indicator i.e. Currently 14 per cent of the population of Tokmok 4480 are considered poor or extremely poor. Sexdisaggregation is relevant but not available.

Even though the final target is not available looking at the ratio of I 147718 it can be assumed to identify with the baseline value. Indeed the project aims at improving Watsan for the entire population.
